reason: Settlement emails already look like spam to me, and a new site asking me to make an account so I can go file somewhere else feels like a data grab. I am not giving a startup my address or phone for a check I was never going to claim.
objection: Is this a scam or a data grab? Free during beta, then a paid model later, plus an account — that is the same pattern as every notice I delete.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse with no account and no personal info, and my bank or a government site sent me there instead of some domain I have never heard of.
